Introduction
The setting of this story involves elements of intellectual challenge, locked room mysteries, deception, manipulation and Lies.
Lies are both a weapon and a weakness that can be exploited. The following feat takes place in the Hell of Tongue-Ripping, the 18th layer of Hell as per Chinese Mythology from the Tang era.

This is a layer where lies are forbidden, and therefore liars are punished with ‘death’. But still, people lie, deceive and manipulate to survive this hell. The Primary Rule above all is Lying is Forbidden
Novice Tutorial and Novice Instances - Introduction
18 people are added in this tutorial level, after the completion of which, they shall move on with
Novice Instance
(Think of Instances as a Level in a game, which can comprise of multiple sub instances/levels)
The objective of Novice Tutorial is to be the last person/ team to survive, with the possession of the Liar Killer Gun
Participants can be Newbies, entering Hell for the first time. Or Old Players, who have already cleared the
Novice Instance
and are coming back to play

Each Novice Instance is different, people experience different scenarios and objectives to pass them. Players clearing the Novice Instance successfully are eligible for One-star Instances, which are of higher difficulty. They are also promoted to being One-star players.

The Instances are backward compatible, thus old players who had cleared the novice instance can attempt another Novice Instance (w their tutorial). But the level difference cannot be 3 or more. Thus in a One-Star Instance, players upto 3 stars can participate. In a Novice Instance, players up to 2 stars can participate.

Clearing Novice tutorial can allow the person in possession of Liar Killer Gun to claim ownership of it permanently. People with Liar Killer Gun cannot be harmed by others in any way other than the Instance rules/punishments, Liar Kille
r’s shot and Liar Killer Skills (Additional powerups unique to that Liar Killer Gun and can cause different supernatural effects

Liar Killer Guns do not come with Liar Killer Skills by default. But there is a chance to get a skill upon completing the Novice Dungeon. This is also a reason for Old Players to play the Novice Instances, other than to avoid higher ranked players in One-Star Instances or to bully Newbies and win over em.

A Liar Killer cannot be shot, unless the target has lied and the user announces that the target has lied (This is called Judging the target). If the user announces that the target has lied, but the target hasn’t, the Gun jams. The Gun user can also be judged as lying if this happens, leading to him being shot if needed.
In the Novice Tutorial, the gun does not have a permanent Owner. Thus if the current user is proved to have lied, the gun falls out of hand, and the previous user cannot pick up the gun again.

Thus, Lies can act as a person’s weakness, making the person vulnerable to being killed by a Liar Killer.. Lies should be defined enough to judge targets accurately, and the criteria to consider a statement a Lie is given next page.
Definition, Criteria and Types of Lies
Definition : A statement that's not true based on objective evidence, or/and is one of the following three types of Lies
Classification of Criteria of Lies, as per Hell’s rules
Emotional Lie: Being controlled by others' emotions, uttering a Lie under anger is considered being a Liar.
Common Sense Lie: Ignoring or misunderstanding basic common sense, uttering statements inconsistent with common sense is considered being a Liar.
Emotional Connection Lie: Regarding the three major human emotions—friendship, kinship, and love—no matter the psychological Reason, telling a Lie is considered being a Liar.
For example:

Emotional Lie: If you are provoked, and you curse the person who angered you as “I'll screw your ancestors”, since his ancestors are already dead, theoretically, you cannot do this. In this situation, you have told a lie.

Common Sense Lie: Based on fundamental common sense, everyone knows there is a sun in the sky, but if you alone do not know this, When others ask you if there is a sun in the sky, regardless of whether you answer "I don't know" or "No," you will be judged to have told a Lie.
Emotional Connection Lie: Your girlfriend is ugly—objectively and generally recognizably ugly. If you comfort her by saying she is beautiful, you are telling a lie.
The three types of lie are related to the three realms of psychology, The Id, The Ego and The SuperEgo. Each controls Emotions, Common Sense and Emotional Connection.

Lies can also be made about the past, present or about the future. Future lies include false promises that can be judged as a lie as soon as the promise is broken. Other lies can be judged so at the moment u can identify it as any of the above types of lies.
Circumstances when a statement won't be considered a lie include
Questions: If a statement is formulated as a question, even if the question has a lie or implies so, it still cannot be considered a lie.
Deductions: Deducing, Decrypting a puzzle, even if the answer is wrong, is not considered a lie.
There is also the Unknown Lie and Gui Yu, but they are not needed for now..

Chen Ran didn't propose the number of questions, meaning each can ask multiple questions

The next person can only ask question after the previous one is answered
The question can’t involve private affairs of one’s past
